body:
WHAT
A finishing rung is an end-of-turn reminder the harness injects before letting a turn end. This one covers the turn that did run a command, but whose Write/Edit text this turn contained a test double (a mock, fake, stub or patch, detected by exact markers such as `jest.mock(`, `class Fake`, `def mock_`). The runtime-evidence reminder is sent with an extra stand-in clause naming those files and saying a passing check against your own double proves only self-consistency; confirm each replaced contract from the real dependency.

WHY
A mock written by the same author as the code agrees with the code by construction, so a green test against it cannot catch a wrong assumption about the real dependency.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/finishing.ts — TEST_DOUBLE_MARKERS, looksLikeTestDouble(text), DOUBLE_CLAUSE prompt (id finishing.double-clause), runtimeEvidenceText(files, vision, doubleFiles) which fills {{doubleNote}}. Fired from engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.observeTurnWork() (adds to doubleFilesThisTurn from the written `content`/`new_string` only, never the disk file) and the `onlyDoubles` branch in runTurn() guarded by the shared `evidenceNudgeFired` fuse.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. looksLikeTestDouble('jest.mock("x")') and looksLikeTestDouble('class FakeRepo') return true; looksLikeTestDouble('const mock = 1') returns false (no high-precision marker).
2. runtimeEvidenceText(['a.ts'], false, ['a.test.ts']) contains 'stand-ins you wrote yourself (a.test.ts)' and 'proves your code is self-consistent'; with doubleFiles [] the text contains no 'stand-ins you wrote yourself'.
3. With FakeProvider scripting a Write of src/x.ts, a Write of src/x.test.ts whose content contains 'vi.mock(', a Bash call, then end_turn, the session pushes exactly one user reminder containing the stand-in clause and emits command_output '↻ checked against your own stand-in — confirm the real contract'.
4. In the same scenario the 'nothing was run' shape does not fire (a command ran), so only one evidence reminder appears in the whole turn even if the model tries to end twice.
5. If the pre-existing file on disk already contained 'jest.mock(' but the Edit new_string this turn does not, the file is not added to doubleFilesThisTurn and no stand-in clause is sent.
